original_test_intent: Inventory all required UBB firmware components against the approved BKC release notes, apply the exact signed PLDM bundle through Redfish UpdateService, prove successful terminal task completion and AC activation, then verify every required component and UBB/GPU health after the cycle.
original_method: Bind the exact SUT/BMC/UBB/GPU/retimer identity; collect complete paginated pre-inventory and active/staged fields; validate BKC component/version matrix, signed PLDM/checksum/compatibility and upload syntax; after explicit authorization POST once, retain response/task ID and monitor state/messages to terminal success; perform one approved AC cycle; re-collect all components and health, stopping on any partial/missing/mismatch state.
manual_activity: The owner approves the BKC matrix, signed bundle, endpoint/syntax, maintenance/update/AC and recovery; an operator monitors task, console and power; the owner decides the verdict from complete post-cycle evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/UBB/GPU/retimer identities and current active/staged inventory
BKC release notes with authoritative component names and expected versions
Signed PLDM bundle, checksum/signature, compatibility and rollback/recovery image
Protected Redfish UpdateService/TaskService endpoint/schema and upload Content-Type/action contract
Maintenance, stable power, controlled AC cycle, console and vendor recovery/RMA plan
Explicit authorization for POST and AC activation
safety_requirements: Use protected credentials and TLS/hostname validation
Do not use malformed source examples, fixed IP or guessed Content-Type/endpoint
Never upload an unsigned, mismatched or unapproved bundle
Capture complete POST response, task location/ID, states, messages and exits
Do not equate 100 percent with terminal success
Perform AC cycle only after approved task state and once authorized
Stop on any partial/error/timeout, identity loss, missing component or version/health mismatch
No automatic POST, retry or repeated power cycle
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete protected pre-inventory and compare with BKC
Validate supplied PLDM artifacts and prepare exact upload/task/AC plan
Execute POST and AC cycle only after explicit current approvals
Monitor task and collect complete post-cycle inventory/health
Perform no bundle/target/version choice, partial-update disposition, recovery/retry decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BKC component matrix, bundle artifacts, endpoint/content type and task semantics
Approve maintenance, POST, AC activation and recovery/RMA plan
Review all component versions and health and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its two inventory reads are valid supplemental prechecks but insecure and incomplete; they cannot cover upload, task, AC activation or post-update acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected Redfish to capture full inventory, POST exactly one verified PLDM bundle after approval, follow the returned task resource to terminal success, AC-cycle once with approval and revalidate all components/health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FirmwareInventory, retimer_active, Bundle/IFWI/SMC/SMC_FPGA/Retimer/RMI/ROT/UBB_FPGA scope, PLDM UpdateService POST, returned task ID, 100-percent intent, AC cycle, post-check, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain; malformed examples require approved correction.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable BKC/artifact/target manifests, complete pre-inventory, one protected upload, schema-aware task monitoring, one controlled activation cycle and complete post-inventory/health diff.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact integrity, secure protocol, task-state rigor and recovery without narrowing source coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Inventory reads alone cannot prove flash, activation or multi-component consistency; progress alone cannot prove success.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A partial bundle update can isolate the UBB/GPU management or compute fabric and require vendor recovery/RMA.

No-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit, recovery evidence and engineer verdict

DeepSeek covers only two insecure reads and uses invalid PARTIAL classification.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2051 Wistron-AMD SVM-01062-V003: approve the exact BKC component/member mapping including RM versus RMI and Bundle/retimer_active, signed PLDM/checksum/compatibility, protected UpdateService Content-Type/action and returned TaskService terminal-success semantics, AC activation sequence, complete post-version/health criteria and recovery/RMA plan.

review_improvement: Converts a narrow invalid PARTIAL review into the complete multicomponent update lifecycle, resolves all destructive gates and preserves every pre/post component and activation check.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PLDM bundle may update several components asynchronously, so a successful upload or 100-percent counter can coexist with terminal failure, pending activation or a partial component set. Component identity and version must be compared before and after the approved activation cycle against a single BKC matrix. Malformed example syntax is unsafe to execute, and a second blind upload or AC cycle could worsen a partial update, so failures must halt for vendor-directed recovery.
